reference.title: opcUaClient-OpcUaClientPointFolder
reference.shortdesc: This component is the OPC UA cClient implementation of a folder under an OPC UA device Points extension. You add such folders using the New Folder button in this component’s Opc Ua Client Point Manager. This folder is also available in the opcUaClient palette.

section.p: This folder is also available in the opcUaClient palette.
